html.promptExtractionHint:
Turns on automatic prompt extraction — you do not need to write any special markup in the System prompt yourself. When checked, the app automatically appends an instruction like this to your System prompt behind the scenes:
Whenever you suggest a prompt for the user to reuse in another generative AI tool, wrap each suggestion in: <prompt type="image" description="short description">prompt text</prompt>
So your System prompt can stay focused on the actual task, e.g. "You are a creative assistant that helps brainstorm and refine prompts for AI image generators." — leave unchecked to disable extraction for this preset.
